I purchased this expecting a neuroscience/neuroanatomy study guide based on the listing description, which describes it as a "Neuroscience Cheat Sheet" and "Neuroanatomy Quick Reference". Unfortunately, the content doesn't really match those expectations.

The sheets are visually clean and easy to read, but they are largely psychoeducational or self-help style worksheets rather than neuroscience reference materials. Most pages focus on stress, emotions, habits and behavioural coaching, with sections such as "Common Confusions", "Support Bridge" and "Micro-Script" rather than anatomy, neural pathways, functions, clinical relevance or scientific evidence.

The design is good, but I feel the marketing overstates the material's scientific and educational depth.
